title: Etale residue triple ideal refinement
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $p$ a prime, $K$ a field, and $\chi:\kappa(p)\to K$ a field homomorphism. For a triple $t=(B,\alpha,q,\phi)$ in [def-weil-pbc-etale-residue-triples] and $f\in q$, there are a triple $s=(B_s,\alpha_s,q_s,\phi_s)$ and a morphism $a:t\to s$ whose underlying ring map sends $f$ into the ideal $pB_s$, the extension along $\alpha_s$.

proof.text: Equip B with the R-algebra induced by alpha. Convert scheme etaleness to Algebra.Etale using HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff and RingHom.etale_algebraMap. Since q lies over p, Algebra.isUnramifiedAt_iff_map_eq gives p B_q equal to the maximal ideal. Map f in q into B_q and use IsLocalization.algebraMap_mem_map_algebraMap_iff to obtain g outside q with g*f in pB.

Apply etaleResidueTriple_unit_refinement to g to obtain a successor s and a morphism a with the image of g a unit. The Under-category morphism relation gives alpha_t followed by the ring map beta equal to alpha_s. Ideal.map_map and Ideal.mem_map_of_mem therefore carry g*f into pB_s. Rewrite beta(g*f) as beta(g)*beta(f), then apply Ideal.unit_mul_mem_iff_mem to cancel the unit beta(g).

proof_origin: Stacks Project Tags 04GN and 04GP, with Tag 00U4(1); the principal-localization construction is reused through unit refinement. Lean ideal transport and unit cancellation by A3, 2026-10-12.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleResidueTriple_ideal_refinement
    (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (p : Spec R) (K : Type u) [Field K]
    (χ : (Spec R).residueField p ⟶ CommRingCat.of K)
    (t : EtaleResidueTriples R p K χ) (f : t.B) (hf : f ∈ t.q.asIdeal) :
    ∃ (s : EtaleResidueTriples R p K χ) (a : t ⟶ s),
      ((etaleResidueTriplesRingDiagram R p K χ).map a).hom f ∈
        p.asIdeal.map s.α.hom
